canonical_statement: For every integer n >= 3, center a in R^n, and scale lambda > 0, the positive function U(x) = [n(n-2)]^((n-2)/4) * (lambda / (lambda^2 + |x-a|^2))^((n-2)/2) solves -Delta U = U^((n+2)/(n-2)) on R^n and is an equality case of the sharp homogeneous Sobolev inequality.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: n : Nat with 3 <= n; EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n); a x in that space; lambda : Real with 0 < lambda; analytic and fractional-power encodings remain to be selected
quantifiers: for every center a in R^n
for every x in R^n for the pointwise PDE identity
conclusion: The normalized bubble is positive and smooth, satisfies the critical semilinear elliptic equation, belongs to the homogeneous Sobolev class, and attains equality in the sharp Sobolev inequality.
boundary_and_exclusions: The scale lambda = 0 and negative scales are excluded
